name.value: Birds of a Feather Bed and Breakfast

description.value: Birds of a Feather is a purpose-built, licensed-since-1997 luxury waterfront B&B situated on the Esquimalt Lagoon Migratory Bird Sanctuary in Colwood, just west of Victoria. Three self-contained studio suites on the upper floor each feature private entrances, ocean lagoon views, gas fireplaces, and radiant heated floors. The property explicitly caters to guests arriving by bicycle and kayak, and offers hosted day trips and boat tours of the Gulf Islands.
